name: qiaomu-ai-prd
title_zh: AI 能照做的 PRD，从一句话想法开始
tagline_zh: 还在为写需求文档熬夜？把模糊想法丢进来，自动生成含验收标准、边界条件的可执行 PRD，AI 开发直接照做。
tagline_en: Stop writing PRDs from scratch. Drop in a vague idea, get a structured spec with acceptance criteria and edge.
desc_en: Generate AI-implementable product requirement documents (PRDs) from one-line product ideas, vague app/site/tool requests, or feature concepts. Use when the user asks for PRD, 产品需求文档, 需求文档, AI 可执行 PRD, 产品规格, MVP 方案, app/site/tool planning, or developer handoff docs for AI coding assistants.
why_zh: 不是模板填空，而是把一句话想法拆解成用户故事、数据模型、异常分支，让 AI 能真正开工，减少来回确认。
why_en: It doesn't just fill a template—it decomposes a raw idea into user stories, data models, and edge cases, so AI can start coding.
limit_zh: 只处理产品需求文档的生成，不含代码实现或测试；对非软件类需求（如硬件、流程优化）效果有限。
limit_en: Only generates PRDs for software products; no code or tests. Limited for non-software needs. Requires clear target user and core scenario input.
